title: LEDGERLIB-117: Contradictory acceptance test expectations
body:
The acceptance tests for LEDGERLIB-117 have contradictory expectations:

- test_interest expects: late_fee(120000, '2024-05-02', 30, '2024-06-04', 1800) == 59
- test_regression_issue_459 expects: late_fee(120000, '2024-05-02', 30, '2024-06-04', 1800) == 60

The spec docstring states actual/365 basis: balance_cents * annual_rate_bp * days_late / (10000 * 365)

Calculation: 120000 * 1800 * 1 / 3650000 = 59.178... which rounds to 59 with half_up.

The regression test value of 60 would require actual/360 (banker's year), which contradicts the spec.

Please update test_regression_issue_459 to expect 59, or clarify if the spec should be changed to actual/360.
